title: Sensient Announces Conference Call
summary: Sensient Technologies Corporation (NYSE: SXT) will hold its earnings call and webcast to discuss 2026 first quarter results at 8:30 a.m. CDT on Friday, April 24, 2026. Investors may access the live webcast on the Company’s web site at investor.sensient.com . Alternatively, investors may join the conference call by contacting Chorus Call Inc. at (844) 492-3726 or (412) 317-1078. A webcast replay will be available on the Company’s web site following the call. The call transcript will be available on the Company’s web site on or after April 28, 2026. About Sensient Technologies Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and personal care industries.
